# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, report them via GitHub's private [Security Advisories](../../security/advisories/new) feature. Include as much detail as possible: a description of the issue, steps to reproduce, and potential impact.

Include a description, reproduction steps, affected versions, and potential impact. Please do not attach real invoices, credentials, or personal data. Acknowledgment and remediation timing depend on maintainer availability; no fixed response SLA is offered.
